headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians 5-2, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense. Max Muncy hit a home run and drove in two runs to lead the Los Angeles Dodgers to a 2-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 12-2, with Nick Fortes contributing a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Baltimore Orioles placing catcher Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Athletics have also been impacted, with J.T. Ginn being placed on the 15-day injured list for a right middle finger blister. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Kansas City Royals, Arizona Diamondbacks, Detroit Tigers, Texas Rangers, and Los Angeles Dodgers.

Several trades have been made, with the Houston Astros acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin from the Kansas City Royals. The Los Angeles Dodgers also made a move, acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies. The Chicago Cubs acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics, while the Baltimore Orioles received Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 5-2 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, securing a crucial win. Max Muncy led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched a strong 7 innings for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Rays Cruise Past Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate. Machado hit two home runs and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Orioles Place Samuel Basallo on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles catcher Samuel Basallo has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation, effective retroactive to July 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
